'''Charles Clarkson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at a sanctioned tournament in Rochester, New York on 31 July 1999 with Endor mains with Obi-Wan and Luke, according to Dan Kurycki's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-11-rochester-ny-7-31-99d3/ rochester-ny-7-31-99], DeckTech (Dan "Giddyup21" Kurycki, 11 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-11-rochester-ny-7-31-99d3/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Card credits ==
Charles Clarkson is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] for the original concept of one card.<ref name="cardlabels-0bc4377d9">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The card is in [[Virtual Block 4]]. The occasions named in the concept credits date from 2006.
One card in all (Concept: 1).<ref name="cardlabels-0bc4377d9" /> The tables give each card, its side, its set and the set's release date, the card it was made from (the title in the strip along the card's bottom edge, when it differs), and the credit exactly as printed. The same credits are listed under [[Card Credits#Charles Clarkson|Charles Clarkson]] on the Card Credits page.<ref name="cardcredits">[[Card Credits]], SWCCG Wiki (generated from card_labels.json at commit 0bc4377d9).</ref>
